# Free Quota    API Endpoints

The curated collection of APIs with Free
Quotas.


## Verified Free APIs (17)

G


### Google AI Studio

Google Verified


Free API
Top Pick


Google AI Studio is a web-based prototyping environment for developers to experiment with Gemini models. It offers a generous free tier that includes access to the latest Gemini 1.5 and 2.0 models, including Flash and Pro versions. It is designed for fast iteration and development, providing a seamless path from prototype to production with the Gemini API.

Gemini 2.0 Flash

Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite

Gemini 1.5 Flash
+1 more

15-30 Requests per minute

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/google-ai-studio)

G


### Groq

Groq Verified


Free API
Top Pick


LPU Inference Engine.

Allam 2 7B

Llama 3.1 8B

Llama 3.3 70B
+1 more

30 Requests per minute, 14.4k Requests per day

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/groq-cloud)

O


### OpenRouter

OpenRouter Verified


Free API
Top Pick


A community-focused router for LLMs. Offers a specific list of truly free models with shared quotas.

Google: Gemini 2.0 Flash (free)

Google: Gemini 2.0 Pro (free)

Meta: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct (free)
+1 more

20 requests/minute

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/openrouter)

T


### Together.AI

Together Verified


Free API


Access specific free research models from ServiceNow and others. Currently hosting the Apriel Thinker series for free.

Apriel 1.6 15B Thinker (Free)

Apriel 1.5 15B Thinker (Free)


Subject to availability

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/together-ai)

H


### Hugging Face Inference

Hugging Face Verified


Free API
Top Pick


The Hugging Face Serverless Inference API allows you to access over 100,000 publicly available machine learning models. It is designed for prototyping and testing, allowing you to run inference on models without managing infrastructure. While not for heavy production, it offers a generous free tier for experimentation.

Llama 3.2 11B Vision

Llama 3.1 8B Instruct

Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct
+1 more

300 Requests / hour

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/huggingface-inference)

C


### Cerebras

Cerebras Verified


Free API
Top Pick


Cerebras Systems offers the world's fastest AI inference service, powered by the Wafer-Scale Engine (WSE-3). It delivers instant speed for Llama and other open-source models, making it ideal for real-time applications and complex reasoning tasks.

Llama 3.1 8B (Fast)

Llama 3.1 70B (Fast)

Llama 4 Scout (Fast)
+1 more

30 Requests per minute

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/cerebras)

M


### Mistral (La Plateforme)

Mistral AI Verified


Free API


Mistral Experiment plan. Requires opting into data training and phone verification.

Mistral 7B

Mixtral 8x7B

Mistral Small
+1 more

1 request/second

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/mistral-ai)

C


### Cohere

Cohere Verified


Free API


Models share a common monthly quota.

Command R+ (08-2024)

Command R (08-2024)

Command R7B (12-2024)
+1 more

20 requests/minute

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/cohere)

G


### GitHub Models

GitHub Verified


Free API


Free access to GPT-4o, Llama, Mistral and more through GitHub's model marketplace. Requires a GitHub account. Limits vary by Copilot tier.

GPT-4o

Llama 3.3 70B Instruct

Phi-4
+1 more

50 Requests per day (high-tier) / 150 Requests per day (mini-tier)

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/github-models)

O


### OVH AI Endpoints

OVHcloud Verified


Free API
Top Pick


OVHcloud's AI Endpoints in Beta. Access open source models hosted in Europe including Qwen3Guard, Audio, and Image generation models.

Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B (Beta)

Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B (Beta)

stable-diffusion-xl-base-v10
+1 more

2 Requests per minute (Anonymous) / 400 Requests per minute (Auth)

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/ovh-ai)

C


### Chutes.ai

Chutes Verified


Free API


Free GPU-powered inference for open-source models. Chutes runs models on donated and idle GPU capacity, offering truly free access to models like Llama 3.1, DeepSeek, and more.

DeepSeek-R1

Llama 3.1 70B Instruct

Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct


Varies (community capacity)

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/chutes-ai)

C


### Cloudflare Workers AI

Cloudflare Verified


Free API


Run AI models on Cloudflare's global network. Workers AI gives you a generous free tier of 10,000 neurons per day across dozens of open-source models including Llama, Mistral, and more. No credit card required.

Llama 3.1 8B Instruct

Llama 3.2 3B Instruct

Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2
+1 more

Varies by model

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/cloudflare-workers-ai)

C


### Coze

ByteDance Verified


Free API


ByteDance's AI platform offering free access to build and deploy AI chatbots and agents. Provides free API access with generous limits to multiple models including GPT-4o and Gemini.

GPT-4o (via Coze)

Gemini 1.5 Pro (via Coze)


Varies by model

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/coze)

G


### Glhf.chat

Glhf Verified


Free API


Free serverless inference for open-source models. Access Llama, Mistral, and other models through an OpenAI-compatible API with generous free tier. Simple, developer-friendly platform.

Llama 3.1 70B Instruct

Mixtral 8x7B Instruct

Phi-3 Mini 4K Instruct


30 Requests per minute

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/glhf-chat)

I


### Inference.net

Inference.net Verified


Free API


Decentralized GPU network offering free inference for open-source models. Built on distributed compute, providing reliable access to Llama, DeepSeek, and other models at no cost.

DeepSeek-R1

Llama 3.1 8B Instruct

Llama 3.1 70B Instruct


30 Requests per minute (fair use)

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/inference-net)

K


### Kluster.ai

Kluster Verified


Free API


Free batch inference API for LLMs. Optimized for high-throughput batch processing with support for Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek and more. Perfect for bulk text processing at zero cost.

Llama 3.1 405B Instruct

DeepSeek-R1

Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct


Batch-based (async)

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/kluster-ai)

Z


### Z.AI (GLM)

Z.AI

Free API


Zhipu AI's global platform for the GLM model family. GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.7-Flash are free, rate-limited models with strong coding performance, served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

GLM-4.5-Flash

GLM-4.7-Flash


~1 request/second (Flash models)

[View Details](https://free-llm.com/api/z-ai)

### No free APIs found

The database might be syncing. Check back soon.
